name: Chronic Osteomyelitis
definition: Persistent or recurrent bone infection characterized by necrotic bone, sinus formation, implant involvement or recurrent inflammatory episodes.

investigations.principle: Radiographs/CT assess sequestrum and bone architecture; MRI assesses active extent; deep cultures guide treatment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Definitive care often requires combined surgical and antimicrobial treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-Shotha framework is secondary to modern infection eradication.

patientEducation.summary: Persistent or recurrent bone infection characterized by necrotic bone, sinus formation, implant involvement or recurrent inflammatory episodes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
